title: pPrDefault w:ind is the root of every paragraph's indent chain: Normal, Normal-based and basedOn-less styles take it, a style or direct w:ind overrides per attribute
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-29), pymupdf line boxes, Letter 1440 margins, Calibri 11, docDefaults ind left 567 right 567 firstLine 720: first lines x 136.35 and continuation lines 100.35 for the unstyled, Body (basedOn Normal) and Root (no basedOn) paragraphs, right edge 512 (= 540 - 28.35); NoFirst (firstLine 0) 100.35 throughout; direct ind left 0 -> 108.00 then 72.00 (firstLine and right kept); Hang (hanging 360) 82.35 then 100.35; direct firstLine 0 -> 100.35

cases.note: a style without w:basedOn inherits docDefaults only, the indent included
unstyled paragraph: Word x 136.35 first line, 100.35 after
Root style paragraph laid out exactly like the unstyled one
direct w:ind left=0 cancels the left indent only: Word x 108.00 then 72.00, right edge still 512
